note: Clause "MUST be set to 0": (a) forbidden: an MP_REACH_NLRI whose Reserved octet is non-zero on send, e.g. inherited from a pooled buffer. (b) rfc4760_reserved_test.go TestRFC4760ReservedIsWrittenNotInherited asserts buf[reserved]==0 over a 0xAA-poisoned buffer at a non-zero offset for six next-hop forms, and TestRFC4760ReservedSurvivesBufferReuse asserts 0 where the previous encode left 0x11; both go red if MPReachNLRI.WriteTo stops writing the octet. Single-polarity marker on the row: there is no non-zero form Ze could emit to reject.
